steps.name:
expect("git fetch --quiet --depth=1 origin gh-pages
git checkout --quiet -B gh-pages FETCH_HEAD
mkdir -p badges
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/mutation-badge.json" badges/mutat... <truncated>).toContain("git fetch")

expect("git fetch --quiet --depth=1 origin gh-pages
git checkout --quiet -B gh-pages FETCH_HEAD
mkdir -p badges
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/mutation-badge.json" badges/mutat... <truncated>).toContain("origin gh-pages")

expect("git fetch --quiet --depth=1 origin gh-pages
git checkout --quiet -B gh-pages FETCH_HEAD
mkdir -p badges
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/mutation-badge.json" badges/mutat... <truncated>).not.toMatch("/--orphan|--force|push -f|git rm/")

expect("git fetch --quiet --depth=1 origin gh-pages
git checkout --quiet -B gh-pages FETCH_HEAD
mkdir -p badges
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/mutation-badge.json" badges/mutat... <truncated>).toContain("git add badges/mutation.json")

expect("git fetch --quiet --depth=1 origin gh-pages

mkdir -p badges
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/mutation-badge.json" badges/mutat... <truncated>).not.toMatch("/git add (--all|-A|\.)/")
